info.name: Creident — local simulated API walkthrough
info.description: Synthetic demo only. Start a LOCAL server with PAYPAL_MODE=simulated and AI_MODE=replay; leave PP/AI keys empty. Node >=22.13. Run all 40 requests in order with Newman --bail or Postman Collection Runner. baseUrl defaults to http://localhost:3000; only loopback HTTP origins are permitted. reviewerCode is empty by default; if the local reviewer gate is configured, set its value only in your private local environment, never export it. Scripts pass new deal, order, evidence, AI draft and PayPal case ids; reset them at the start. The expected 409 mode probe and the documented unavailable completeness replay are deliberate checks, not server failures. No webhooks are forged, no public URL is needed, and no external provider should be called. The run creates two labelled deals in addition to seeded examples and leaves them in the database. Re-run creates new walkthrough deals; use a fresh CREIDENT_DB_PATH for an isolated run. A simulated refund decision before capture voids an authorization. A second completed deal demonstrates an external freeze, polling, inquiry message, claim escalation and locked PDF submission locally. Rules recommend; the reviewer request explicitly chooses the outcome. No AI output alone changes a payment.

exec: if (!/^http:\/\/(localhost|127\.0\.0\.1|\[::1\])(?::[0-9]+)?$/.test(origin)) { pm.execution.skipRequest(); throw new Error('This walkthrough permits a local loopback HTTP baseUrl only, without a trailing slash.'); }
const modeProbe = pm.info.requestName === '03 Verify simulated mode (expected 409)';

if (!modeProbe && paymentOrBridge && pm.collectionVariables.get('simulatedVerified') !== 'true') { pm.execution.skipRequest(); throw new Error('Run the collection in order; simulated-mode verification must precede payment or bridge actions.'); }

item.name: 1. Seed and verify local simulation
item.description: Run the entire collection in order. Seeded examples and newly created deals are labelled demo data. The expected 409 probe checks simulated mode without creating a PayPal case or moving money.

item.name: 01 Seed labelled demo deals

request.description: Adds missing labelled examples; accepts 201 on a fresh database or 200 when the examples already exist. Does not depend on the seed count (C21 adds another example).

exec: if (![200, 201].includes(pm.response.code)) { pm.execution.setNextRequest(null); throw new Error('Seed failed'); }
pm.test('Seed reports a count and skip flag', function () { pm.expect(hvResponse.created).to.be.a('number').and.at.least(0); pm.expect(hvResponse.skipped).to.be.a('boolean'); });

request.description: Creates a NEW deal each run. The exact synthetic terms/evidence match the existing copilot replay. It does not modify the seeded Smartwatch.

pm.test('Demo label and terms are retained', function () { pm.expect(hvResponse.transaction.item).to.eql('[Demo] Smartwatch'); pm.expect(JSON.parse(hvResponse.transaction.termsJson).demo).to.eql(true); });

item.name: 03 Verify simulated mode (expected 409)

request.description: A DRAFT is ineligible for a PayPal case, so simulated mode returns INVALID_STATE (409) before gateway calls. Sandbox mode returns 404 instead and must stop the run. This expected negative response is not a failed test.

exec: if (pm.response.code !== 409) { pm.execution.setNextRequest(null); throw new Error('Unexpected HTTP status; stop this simulated demo run.'); }
pm.test('Simulation enabled; draft cannot open a PayPal case', function () { pm.expect(hvResponse.error).to.eql('INVALID_STATE'); });
if (hvResponse.error !== 'INVALID_STATE') { pm.execution.setNextRequest(null); throw new Error('Start the server with PAYPAL_MODE=simulated'); }

exec: if (pm.response.code !== 200) { pm.execution.setNextRequest(null); throw new Error('Unexpected HTTP status; stop this simulated demo run.'); }
pm.test('Seed is idempotent', function () { pm.expect(hvResponse).to.deep.equal({created: 0, skipped: true}); });

item.name: 4. Audit read, CSV and chain verification
item.description: Checks the new dispute deal, including locked terms/evidence basis hashes and copilot acceptance metadata. CSV payload remains canonical JSON; the assertion counts CSV records without splitting quoted newlines.

item.name: 23 Read the decision audit and verify its chain

exec: if (pm.response.code !== 200) { pm.execution.setNextRequest(null); throw new Error('Unexpected HTTP status; stop this simulated demo run.'); }

pm.test('Chain and human decision basis verify', function () { pm.expect(hvResponse.verification.ok).to.eql(true); const decision = hvResponse.events.find(e => e.type === 'DECISION'); pm.expect(decision.payload.outcome).to.eql('REFUND'); pm.expect(decision.payload.termsHash).to.match(/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/); pm.expect(decision.payload.evidenceDigest).to.match(/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/); pm.expect(decision.payload.aiDraft.accepted).to.eql('unchanged'); pm.expect(hvResponse.events.find(e => e.type === 'RETURN_DELIVERED').payload.simulated).to.eql(true); });

for (let i = 0; i < csv.length; i++) { if (csv[i] === '"') { if (quoted && csv[i + 1] === '"') i++; else quoted = !quoted; } else if (csv[i] === '\n' && !quoted) records++; }

pm.test('CSV row count equals audit events', function () { pm.expect(quoted).to.eql(false); pm.expect(records - 1).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('auditCount'))); pm.expect(csv.split('\r\n')[0]).to.eql('seq,ts,actor,type,simulated,prevHash,hash,payload'); });
